description: Na₄MgC₆(NS)₆ crystallizes in the trigonal P̅31c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three equivalent N and three equivalent S atoms. All Na-N bond lengths are 2.49 Å. All Na-S bond lengths are 2.97 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six equivalent S atoms. All Na-S bond lengths are 3.02 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent S atoms. All Na-S bond lengths are 3.05 Å. Mg is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six equivalent N atoms. All Mg-N bond lengths are 2.15 Å. C is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one N and one S atom. The C-N bond length is 1.18 Å. The C-S bond length is 1.62 Å. N is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one C atom. S is bonded to three Na and one C atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SNa₃C trigonal pyramids.
